decisions.question: Style direction

decisions.question: Find in text (O-4)
decisions.answer: Add to M-1

decisions.answer: Yes in M-1 (cache-only service worker, ADR-0012)

decisions.question: Spec clarifications O-1..O-3

decisions.answer: Yes

decisions.question: Gate G2 designs

decisions.question: WebKit service worker vs NFR-01
decisions.answer: Amend NFR-01: browser's own install/update fetches of the tool's own files allowed

decisions.question: Syntax colouring threshold
decisions.answer: Keep 10 MB; accept lag 2-10 MB (NFR-02 exception)

decisions.question: F-007 download-blocked requirement
decisions.answer: Deprecate F-007.R5/AC6; Copy fallback covers it

decisions.question: NFR-04 memory wording
decisions.answer: 1.5 GB measured after GC on Chromium; best effort on WebKit/Gecko

decisions.question: WebKit limits at 100 MB
decisions.answer: Accept: scroll stutter and copy >120 MB fallback as known limits; revisit M-3

decisions.question: Reuse portal design tokens (DEP-14)
decisions.answer: Owner's own work; reuse freely

decisions.question: Gate G3 stack approval
decisions.answer: Approved; ADRs accepted incl. spike amendments

decisions.question: Large undo Blobs may page to browser temp files vs NFR-01
decisions.answer: Accept; clarify NFR-01

decisions.answer: 320 px (NFR-06 WCAG 2.2 AA reflow overrides NFR-07's 360)

decisions.answer: Pass G5; all manual checks move to the phase-6 release checklist, signed off before publishing

decisions.question: Busy look for tool operations (toolbar flashed disabled on every action)
decisions.answer: Never disable visually: controls keep their normal look while busy (still blocked, editor read-only); only the progress bar (after 0.5 s) signals busy

decisions.answer: Outcome notices (no_indent, multiple_files, error bars) clear when another tool action starts or the document changes; large and undo_trimmed stay until dismissed
